memberdef.name: XPm_HousecleanCheck

detaileddescription.para: Skip only when both samples indicate the function is disabled.

briefdescription.para: Runs Arteris built-in self-test (ABIST) for PL-related LPD, FPD, and ASU Domains.

detaileddescription.para: Tests only the selected LPD AFIFS, FPD AFIFS, and INTASU PL controllers whose base-register reads are nonzero. Each ABIST is only required to execute once after booting. Skips testing on QEMU and COSIM platforms or when housecleaning disables PLD ABIST.

Temporarily enables the RCLK clock outputs and restores CRP_RCLK_CTRL before returning. For each tested controller, disables interrupts, starts BIST, polls for completion, and checks for a latent fault. Clears BIST completion and polls for mission mode before recording successful completion. Subsequent calls skip controllers already marked complete.

parameterdescription.para: OR of XPM_ABIST_LPD_MASK, XPM_ABIST_FPD_MASK, and XPM_ABIST_ASU_MASK. Zero selects no controllers.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if all attempted tests succeed or no test runs.
XST_FAILURE if a latent fault is detected.
Polling failure status if BIST completion or mission-mode polling fails.

simplesect.para: A zero base-register read leaves that controller eligible for a subsequent call. Success does not imply every controller completed ABIST. Completion flags persist across calls until software reinitializes them.
